posts.title: The Registry Under the Ballot
posts.description: Yesterday, Brazil ran the second round of its 2026 presidential election. About 158.7 million people were registered to vote, spread across roughly half a million polling sections. By Sunday night, 100% of sections had been totalized and the country knew the result: 64.3 million votes to 59.8 million, a margin of 3.58 points. posts.title: All Government Is a Tech Company Now (And This Is Not Going Away)
posts.description: Brazil's Central Bank, the Banco Central do Brasil (BCB), is responsible for Pix. It is the country's instant payment rail, launched in November 2020, that reduced peer-to-peer transaction costs to zero and processed R$ 26.5 trillion in 2024 alone, a 54% increase over the prior year, across 63 billion transactions.
